purpose: S7: the matched NON-CAS semantic taxonomy. Only beating this control (and S6) can license the words 'CAS-specific'. Without S7, any S3 win is attributable to generic semantic structure.
status: CANDIDATE -- the frozen table MUST be constructed, balance-checked, and digest-pinned in Gate 1B job-sequence step 3, BEFORE any activation extraction, training, or result exists (single unified timing law)
circularity_disclosure: the dataset's answer function is defined over the CAS classes, so every taxonomy admissible under the orthogonality rule is necessarily MISALIGNED with the answer function; S7 controls for 'an equally structured alternative annotation', not for 'an equally task-aligned one' -- no such control can exist on this dataset (GATE1A_SCOPE_AND_CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md, honest ceilings)

construction_law.resource: an INDEPENDENT FROZEN lexical resource -- WordNet 3.1 verb lexicographer files (lexnames) -- NOT the target Transformer's activations, NOT any model output
construction_law.resource_pinning: the WordNet 3.1 archive SHA-256 is recorded in this manifest before Gate 1B (slot below); the mapping table derived from it is frozen as scmpe_table.json with its own digest

head_verb_table.comment: the REGISTERED head verb per (class, family) -- complete 16-row table (review fix: no extraction ambiguity, no missing rows)

construction_law.mapping_rule: each clause maps via its (class, family) row in head_verb_table to that verb's WordNet 3.1 primary-sense lexname; the four SCMPE classes are the four most populous distinct lexname groups over the 16 registered verbs; verbs in smaller groups join the lexname group of their nearest hypernym-path group, ties broken alphabetically by lexname (executable, no judgment calls)
construction_law.balance_tolerance: each SCMPE class covers 25% +/- 10% of clauses per split; if the tolerance fails, apply the registered EXECUTABLE fallback: repeatedly move the alphabetically-first verb of the largest class to the smallest class until the tolerance holds or 16 moves occur (then reject the taxonomy and use the registered noun-domain alternative); every move is recorded -- never hand-edited per clause
construction_law.orthogonality_check: the SCMPE class must NOT be a relabeling of the CAS class: Cramer's V between SCMPE and CAS labels over train must be <= 0.35, computed and recorded before Gate 1B; if exceeded, the taxonomy is rejected and an alternative registered carving (noun-domain lexnames) is used and recorded

frozen_before_results_law: the final scmpe_table.json digest, the balance counts, and the orthogonality statistic are appended to this manifest and to the execution receipt BEFORE any arm result is computed; after the first protected read, this manifest is immutable
claim_language_law: S3 > S7 (and S3 > S6) on protected data is REQUIRED for 'CAS-specific'; S3 == S7 reads 'generic semantic structure helped; CAS-specific value not established'
